verdict.rationale: Skills run in an isolated code execution container (docs-10) and plugins/skills can be tested locally via the `--plugin-dir` flag before deployment (docs-41), suggesting some sandboxed testing capability, but there is no explicit documentation framing this as a sandbox environment distinct from production data or describing data isolation guarantees. missing for 10: explicit sandbox-vs-production data separation guarantees, dedicated staging/test environment docs, and independent confirmation that local testing avoids production data exposure.
